snippet.title: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Set sail on a voyage to change destiny itself. 

A touching tale set in a world of melancholic beauty, brought to you by the creative minds of YOKO TARO, Keiichi Okabe and Kimihiko Fujisaka.

Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden is out now!
